articles.title: Russia Frees American Teacher Stephen Hubbard
articles.summary: Russia released Stephen Hubbard, a 74-year-old former teacher from Michigan, after a request from President Trump. The U.S. says it gave nothing in return.

articles.title: Websites Around the World Rush to Fix Security Flaw
articles.summary: Officials raced to patch websites worldwide after the FBI and NSA warned that a flaw involving the PHP programming language could let hackers take control.

articles.title: Saving for a First Home Now Takes Twice as Long
articles.summary: A new report says the average renter family now needs about 16 years to save for a starter home, twice as long as in 2019.
